server_release.name: ATMonsFusion-Server-2.1.0-Pterodactyl-Final-v2
server_release.notes: Linux x86_64 Pterodactyl server v2 (Java 21 / NeoForge 21.1.266, Scorched Guns 1.1.2, Sophisticated Inventory Interactions 0.1.15.233 pinned) and cumulative Hotfix-2 (ATMonsFusion-Server-2.1.0-Pterodactyl-Hotfix-2.zip, sha256 76f9d4cbd8cc...). Retires tacz-pack-upgrader-2.1.3.jar in favor of native TaCZ 1.2.0 gunpack overlays, updates Scorched Guns to 1.1.2, pins Sophisticated Inventory Interactions to 0.1.15.233 for Sophisticated Core 1.5.37.2482 compatibility, and fixes KubeJS Tweaks recipe report.

notes: Host converted TaCZ 1.21.1 files so fresh imports work even after launching Minecraft once.
manual_steps: Import All the Mons Fusion-2.1.0.zip in CurseForge. This release uses the ZIP's baseline files and switches off NeoAuth if it is active.

Launch the imported pack to the main menu once, then quit before applying this code. TaCZ first extracts its bundled base gun packs. Approve replacement of the two gunpack.meta.json files if CEMM asks.
Fusion 2.1.0 requires NeoForge 21.1.266. Set that loader version in existing CurseForge profiles before applying this release; CEMM does not install the loader.
Back up your world before the first launch on a new release.
Recover any existing Epitaphs graves before opening an old singleplayer world (Epitaphs was replaced by Graveless).
known_issues: Scorched Guns: the per-round reload/unload casing exploit is not fixed. Avoid unloading during a per-round reload.
